# The ODE system of the model `events_model`.
#
# Written by sbmlode 0.3.3, SBML L3V2.
#
# States x:
#
#      id  name       unit
#   1  V
#   2  S   substrate
#   3  P
#   4  A
#   5  B
#
# `initial_values(p)` returns the initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0,
# `f_dxdt(t, x, p)` the rates of change of the states (in a list, as deSolve
# wants them) and `f_y(t, x, p)` the assigned values y, the rules and the
# reaction rates.
# `EVENTS` lists the events with the functions of their delays, priorities and
# assignments, `event_triggers(t, x, p)` and `event_conditions(t, x, p)` their
# triggers.
# Sourcing the file needs base R only.

# the ids of the states x, the constants p and the assigned values y
XIDS <- c(
  "V",
  "S",  # substrate
  "P",
  "A",
  "B"
)
PIDS <- c(
  "c",
  "vmax",
  "km",
  "k1",
  "S0",
  "total"
)
YIDS <- c(
  "dV_dt",  # rate of V
  "k2",
  "J0",
  "J1"
)

# the names and the units of the ids, `NA` for none
NAMES <- c(
  "V" = NA_character_,
  "S" = "substrate",
  "P" = NA_character_,
  "A" = NA_character_,
  "B" = NA_character_,
  "c" = NA_character_,
  "vmax" = NA_character_,
  "km" = NA_character_,
  "k1" = NA_character_,
  "S0" = NA_character_,
  "total" = NA_character_,
  "dV_dt" = "rate of V",
  "k2" = NA_character_,
  "J0" = NA_character_,
  "J1" = NA_character_
)
UNITS <- c(
  "V" = NA_character_,
  "S" = NA_character_,
  "P" = NA_character_,
  "A" = NA_character_,
  "B" = NA_character_,
  "c" = NA_character_,
  "vmax" = NA_character_,
  "km" = NA_character_,
  "k1" = NA_character_,
  "S0" = NA_character_,
  "total" = NA_character_,
  "dV_dt" = NA_character_,
  "k2" = NA_character_,
  "J0" = NA_character_,
  "J1" = NA_character_
)

# the default values of the constants, `NaN` for one without a value, e.g. one
# which an initial assignment sets and `initial_values` computes
P0 <- c(
  "c" = 1,
  "vmax" = 2,
  "km" = 0.5,
  "k1" = 0.1,
  "S0" = 10,
  "total" = 0
)

mm <- function(S, km) S / (km + S)

# The initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0.
#
# The initial values, initial assignments and the rules they need are evaluated
# in the order of their dependencies.
#
# Every constant keeps the value passed.
#
# Returns a list of the initial states x0 and the constants p, named vectors.
initial_values <- function(p = P0) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  # constants
  S0 <- p[[5]]
  # initial values
  V <- 2
  S <- S0  # substrate
  P <- 0
  A <- 5
  B <- 1
  x0 <- as.numeric(c(V, S, P, A, B))
  names(x0) <- XIDS
  names(p) <- PIDS
  list(x0 = x0, p = p)
}

# The rates of change dx/dt of the states x at the time t, in a list (deSolve).
f_dxdt <- function(t, x, p) {
  # states
  V <- x[[1]]
  S <- x[[2]]  # substrate
  A <- x[[4]]
  B <- x[[5]]
  # constants
  c_ <- p[[1]]
  vmax <- p[[2]]
  km <- p[[3]]
  k1 <- p[[4]]
  # assigned values and reaction rates
  dV_dt <- 0.1  # rate of V
  J0 <- vmax * mm(S, km)
  J1 <- k1 * S * A
  # rates of change
  dx <- numeric(5)
  dx[[1]] <- 0.1  # dV/dt
  dx[[2]] <- (-J0 - J1) / c_  # dS/dt
  dx[[3]] <- (J0 + 2 * J1) / c_  # dP/dt
  dx[[4]] <- -J1 / V - A / V * dV_dt  # dA/dt
  dx[[5]] <- -0.1 * B  # dB/dt
  list(dx)
}

# The assigned values y at the time t, the rules and the reaction rates.
f_y <- function(t, x, p) {
  # states
  S <- x[[2]]  # substrate
  A <- x[[4]]
  # constants
  vmax <- p[[2]]
  km <- p[[3]]
  k1 <- p[[4]]
  # assigned values and reaction rates
  dV_dt <- 0.1  # rate of V
  k2 <- 2 * k1
  J0 <- vmax * mm(S, km)
  J1 <- k1 * S * A
  as.numeric(c(dV_dt, k2, J0, J1))
}

# The root function of the trigger of each event, positive where it holds.
#
# An integrator locates the time at which a trigger changes as a root of its
# function. At a root, where the function is 0, the trigger itself decides, see
# `event_conditions`: `a >= b` holds at `a == b`, `a > b` does not.
event_triggers <- function(t, x, p) {
  # states
  S <- x[[2]]  # substrate
  as.numeric(c(
    t - 5,  # E1 reset
    2 - S  # E2
  ))
}

# Whether the trigger of each event holds.
event_conditions <- function(t, x, p) {
  # states
  S <- x[[2]]  # substrate
  c(
    isTRUE(t > 5),  # E1 reset
    isTRUE(S < 2)  # E2
  )
}

# The priority of the event E1, evaluated before each execution.
event_priority_E1 <- function(t, x, p) {
  1
}

# The values the event E1 assigns, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
event_values_E1 <- function(t, x, p) {
  # states
  V <- x[[1]]
  as.numeric(c(
    2 * V,  # V
    10,  # S substrate
    NaN,  # A: not assigned, its amount is kept
    NaN  # B: not assigned, its amount is kept
  ))
}

# The sizes of the compartments the event E1 changes, after its assignments.
event_sizes_E1 <- function(t, x, p) {
  # states
  V <- x[[1]]
  as.numeric(c(V))
}

# Execute the event E1: a list of the states x and the constants p with the
# values.
#
# A concentration in a compartment whose size the event changes keeps its amount:
# it is scaled with the size before the event and divided by the size after it,
# `event_sizes_E1`, evaluated with the values the event assigned.
event_assign_E1 <- function(t, x, p, values) {
  # states
  V <- x[[1]]
  A <- x[[4]]
  B <- x[[5]]
  x[[1]] <- values[[1]]  # V
  x[[2]] <- values[[2]]  # S substrate
  sizes <- event_sizes_E1(t, x, p)
  x[[4]] <- A * V / sizes[[1]]  # A
  x[[5]] <- B * V / sizes[[1]]  # B
  list(x = x, p = p)
}

# The delay of the event E2, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
event_delay_E2 <- function(t, x, p) {
  1
}

# The values the event E2 assigns, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
event_values_E2 <- function(t, x, p) {
  # constants
  total <- p[[6]]
  as.numeric(c(
    1,  # A
    total + 1  # total
  ))
}

# Execute the event E2: a list of the states x and the constants p with the
# values.
event_assign_E2 <- function(t, x, p, values) {
  x[[4]] <- values[[1]]  # A
  p[[6]] <- values[[2]]  # total
  list(x = x, p = p)
}

# the events in the order of the model: their flags and the functions of their
# delay, priority and assignments; the trigger of EVENTS[[k]] is the entry k of
# `event_triggers` and `event_conditions`
EVENTS <- list(
  list(
    id = "E1",
    initial_value = TRUE,
    persistent = TRUE,
    use_trigger_values = TRUE,
    delay = NULL,
    priority = event_priority_E1,
    values = event_values_E1,
    assign = event_assign_E1
  ),
  list(
    id = "E2",
    initial_value = TRUE,
    persistent = TRUE,
    use_trigger_values = TRUE,
    delay = event_delay_E2,
    priority = NULL,
    values = event_values_E2,
    assign = event_assign_E2
  )
)
